objective: Optimize snt23_2neg_conf_low (b12 best sentiment sh0.53/sub_univ0.77). Test cap-decile/z30/z60/ts_rank variants + other neg level fields (mean/max). FLIP snt21_2pos_std (b12 sh-0.74, expect sh0.74). Retest dts_gen (b12 platform bug with wrong field name).

design.expr1_conf_low_capdecile: snt23_2neg_conf_low + cap-decile z40. Cap-decile was neutral for sentiment std in b12 but conf_low is a level signal (different from std). Re-test on level signal.
design.expr2_conf_low_z30: snt23_2neg_conf_low + z30. z30 was best for asi_jpn in b10/b11.
design.expr3_conf_low_z60: snt23_2neg_conf_low + z60. z60 was best for main sh in prior batches.
design.expr4_neg_mean_z40: snt23_2neg_mean (17 users, 23 alphas) + proven z40. Different level measure (average vs confidence lower bound).
design.expr5_neg_max_z40: snt23_2neg_max (13 users) + proven z40. Max negative sentiment (extreme signal).
design.expr6_FLIP_pos_std: FLIP snt21_2pos_std. b12 sh-0.74 (reversed). Unary minus flips signal. Expected sh~0.74 > analyst best 0.66. Tests if unary minus allowed in FASTEXPR.
design.expr7_dts_gen_212: snt23_2dts_gen_212 (12 users, 30 alphas, General sentiment score) + proven z40. b12 used wrong field name snt23_2dts_gen_20 (does not exist in field list - caused platform duplicate bug). Correct field name verified from sentiment23_fields.json line 4.
design.expr8_conf_low_ts_rank: snt23_2neg_conf_low + ts_rank(30) variant. Replaces ts_mean smoothing with ts_rank momentum. Captures sentiment level momentum vs absolute level.

b12_reference: Best sentiment b12 = snt23_2neg_conf_low sh0.53/sub_univ0.77 (expr6 d5RNezEg). snt21_2pos_std sh-0.74 (reversed, flip->sh0.74 potential). Cap-decile neutral for sentiment std fields.
